title: gentianella pygmaea
intro: Gentianella pygmaea, commonly known as the Alpine Gentian, is a small, delicate plant species that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to aid in digestion and reduce inflammation, while also exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella pygmaea include anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as gastrointestinal disorders and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
